cards.name: Final Attack Orders
cards.officialEffect: All face-up monsters on the field are changed to Attack Position and their battle positions cannot be changed.

cards.name: Light of Intervention
cards.officialEffect: While this card is on the field, Monster Cards cannot be Set or flipped face-down. If a Monster Card would be Set, it must be Normal Summoned in face-up Defense Position.

cards.name: Royal Command
cards.officialEffect: Flip monsters' effects cannot be activated, also their effects are negated.

supports: Set becomes face-up Defense Normal Summon
Flip Effect activation and effect negation

behavior: Final Attack Orders changes every face-up monster on both teams to Attack Position and prevents further battle-position changes while its resolved Continuous Trap remains face-up.
Light of Intervention prevents monsters from being Set or changed face-down; a would-be Set is represented as a face-up Defense Normal Summon.
When both policies are active, Final Attack Orders takes precedence for the resulting face-up monster position.
Face-down monsters already on the field remain face-down when Light of Intervention resolves; a later Flip Summon is still possible.
A partner-set Continuous Trap can be activated by the active teammate while preserving its physical owner UID.
Activation negation sends the Trap to the shared Graveyard; effect negation leaves it face-up but inactive.
A removed or stale source cannot apply its continuous policy; source removal releases the position lock if no other source remains.
The adapter exposes an explicit applyContinuousPolicies hook for face-up monsters entering after activation.
Hands above six are not discarded early; the hand check remains exclusive to the End Phase.
Royal Command blocks activation of Flip Effect monster effects and negates those effects while its resolved Continuous Trap remains face-up; non-Flip monster effects remain eligible.
limitations: Adapter isolado: não altera resolver central, effect registry, catálogo, certificações, allowlist, comandos Discord, banco ou dados persistentes.
Os testes usam IDs físicos já certificados como fixtures e injetam a identidade mecânica; os passcodes reais continuam fora do catálogo.
O host ainda precisa chamar applyContinuousPolicies após efeitos que coloquem monstros face-up e integrar as políticas à validação central de Set/posição.
A conversão de Set em Invocação-Normal é representada no estado do adapter, mas o pipeline de gatilhos de Invocação-Normal continua dependente da integração central.
Sem merge, deploy ou validação de gateway Discord ao vivo.
